english: ...Hmm.
Hm? Something wrong?
Oh, Houki-san.\nNo... um... it's nothing.
No need to hold back.\nWe're comrades, after all.
Sorry... I was just thinking\nabout something really trivial.
Something trivial?
Well... I was thinking\nmaybe I should build a little muscle...
That's a fine attitude.\nWe're living in battle right now, after all.\nYou should do everything you can.
Yeah... you're right.
You need enough muscle\nto keep a healthy body, too.
No... that's not it.
Hm?
But... something feels off about it.
Something bothering you?
What exactly are you agonizing over?
Well... if I got all buff\nand could fight with just my fists,\nmaybe people wouldn't see me as a non-combatant...
You were never a non-combatant to begin with.\nRear support is still\ntaking part in the fight.
Hmm...\nYeah, that does sound like a trivial worry.
Just do what\nyou can do.
I can take the front line\nbecause I've got comrades like you behind me.
Houki-san...
Is that your only worry?\nIf something weird's on your mind,\ntell me anything.
(Houki-san... she's so kind.\nTo worry about someone like me...)
Huh? It won't open.
Hm, what's wrong this time?
Ah... well, I can't get this open.
The jam lid?\nYou can't even open this?
Maybe you should build a little strength after all.
(Wha-! But she just told me\nto do what I can... I can't say that out loud...)
Can't be helped.\nI'll open it.
Sorry... please.
This is nothing... huh?\nNngh!
I-it's pretty tight.
Can't get it open?
N-no, I just let my guard down.\nIt's fine, don't worry.
Nngh! Nnngh!
Please... don't push yourself too hard.
I-I'm not pushing myself.\nIt's a lid-of course it'll open.
Too much even for you, Houki-san?
What's that supposed to mean?\nAre you calling me a musclehead?
No... that's not what I meant.
Wait here a moment.
Ah, where are you-
It's open!
Ah, thank you!
You should build at least\nthis much strength.
...Right.
(This... the lid wasn't so much opened\nas cut clean off...\nShe wants me to build THIS kind of strength...?)
(Plus... now we'll have to finish all this jam\nbefore it goes bad...\nNo... I'll look for another container...)
You always wear a ponytail, Houki-san.
That's right.
No plans to change your hairstyle?
Are you telling me to change it?
No, that's not what I mean-\nit's just that I think anything would suit you.\nWhy not twintails?
Twintails...\nNo, I'm fine as I am.
I don't remember it well, but...\nIt's kind of like a wish I made.
I have no intention of changing it.
A wish...?
I see... then it can't be changed.
Yeah. I think it must be\nsomething important to me.
But you don't remember, right?
W-well, that's true...\nBut it's important to me.
Then maybe I should\nget a ponytail too.
Huh?
No, I mean-if you have that kind of wish\nattached to yours,\nmaybe something of mine would come true if I got a ponytail and made a wish too.
I don't think that's how it works.\nThis is my wish and mine alone.
Besides, I don't think\na ponytail would suit you.
Worst case, the other comrades\nwould keep their distance.
Y-yeah, you're right...\nI'll pass.
Good.
It's nice that everyone has their own special talent.
Where did that come from?
Well, you're good at cooking, Houki-san,\nand I just thought it's enviable to be good at something.
Is that so?\nSurely you've got at least one talent?
No, nothing in particular.\nI'm a little below average, if anything.
No need to put yourself down.\nEven if you're a little below average,\nyou can still do it.
Even I... wasn't always\ngood at cooking, you know.
Really!?
Yeah.\nBut practice always makes you better.
That's just how it is.
How bad were you?
Th-that doesn't matter.\nNo need to dwell on the past.
You'd never know it.\nI can't even imagine you being bad at it.
Is that so?\nThat's nice to hear.
Anyway, the point is to practice.\nThough first you should decide\nwhat you want to get better at.
Y-you're right!\nWhat should I practice... I'll think about it.
Hah... hah... hah...
Worn out already?\nYou're the one who asked me to teach you kendo.
B-but... I can't take any more.
Then let's try a little harder.
Pushing past what feels like your limit\nis what's good for you.
M-my body won't move anymore...
It's fine.\nYou must still have some strength in reserve.
O-okay...
Good! Let's work at it together!
H-hiyaaah...
No, more like... shubat!\nthen bwat!
Huh? Isn't it easier to go basut!\nand then suu-?
No, you go gut! then shutat!\nor you'll never land a hit.
You think...?\nI feel like it's more gant! then zunt! then zuoooh-
Can I say something?
What is it?
Your way of putting it is hard to follow, I think.\nYou should use words\nthat get through to people better.
Ehhh...
(Coming from YOU, Houki-san...)
You've got your own personal unit too, right, Houki-san?
That's right.
What color is it?\nI don't remember.
Main color's red.\nIt's called Akatsubaki.
Red! That's so cool.
I-is it?
It's cool! I really admire it.\nIn sentai shows, red's always the leader!
We're talking about slightly different\nkinds of cool, but thanks.
No reason in particular, it's just cool.
No reason... what do you mean?
No, it's just...\ninstinctively cool, I guess.
Does it have horns?\nMove three times faster or anything!?
No horns,\nbut it's probably fast.\nThough three times faster than what, I wonder.
And it's got\nthat axe-like weapon, right?
No... that's wrong.\nWhat are you even talking about?
No, I mean it's cool.\nThe powered suit.
That's what I'm asking-what are you talking about?\nIt's an IS. An IS.
...Huh? I think I was picturing something a little different.\nWrong personal unit...
How do you mix that up?\nWell, no point blaming you.
Lately, I feel like I've been having you\nlisten to me a lot, Houki-san.
Is that so?
I don't talk much to begin with, but\nI think you're the one I talk to most.
Is that right.\nWell, we're comrades. I can't just leave you be.
Thank you.
If you're ever troubled, Houki-san, I'd like to listen for a change...\nif that's not too presumptuous of me...
No, thank you.\nI'll come to you then.
Well, you don't seem like the type to worry about things, though.
What exactly do you take me for...?
I'll do my best to be of help.
Yeah. I'm counting on it.
Um... Houki-san.\nCan I ask you something?
Ah, sure.
Why do you listen to me?
That's a strange question.\nLike I said,\nwe're comrades. Of course I would.
Is that all you wanted to ask?\nThen I'm off.
(But... her listening to my troubles like this...\ncould it mean...)
So here you are.
Houki-san? Huh? Where is this?
I wanted to talk to you about something.\nCould you come over here?
Um... where is this?
Don't you remember?\nYou said you were going to run a café.
D-did I...?\nWait, huh!? Houki-san? That outfit...?
Th-this is... what I wanted to ask about.\nD-does it look weird?
No! Not at all!\nIt really suits you.
I-is that so! It suits me.\n...Okay.
R-right!\nSince this is a café, won't you order something?
As a café waitress,\nI can't just stand around doing nothing, you know?
Th-then... the recommendation.
R-right, good choice.\nI'll get it ready.
...How's this?
Huh? Did that just come from under the table...?
I had it prepared.\nGood thing you ordered the recommendation.
Order anything else you'd like.\nI'm the waitress, after all.
Um... am I the only one?\nThe only one you invited here?
Th-that's right!\nDon't worry about that, just relax.
(Just me... Could it be... that Houki-san has feelings for me...)
U-uhn? Huh... a dream...\nRight... of course...
There you are.\nI've been looking for you.
Houki-san? Looking for me?
Yeah, there's something I'd like to ask of you.
Something to ask of me...
(Could it be... a prophetic dream)
I got hurt a little.\nIt'd heal on its own, but\nit's kind of noticeable, and it bothers me.
Could you cast a healing spell on me?
I did think about just leaving it, you know?\nBut... what you really need\nis comrades, I figured.
Comrades...
Got a problem with that?
No... thank you.\nThose words make me happy too.
